title: One Sunday with Fate Marable and talk of Foots Thomas
summary: Punch played one Sunday on the boat in place of Louis and discusses Marable's St. Louis men, Foots Thomas and Norman Mason.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: Oh, did you ever work with Fate Marable? Fate Marable?

One Sunday on the boat in Louis' place. One Sunday. Just one. Something was wrong with Louis, couldn't make it. I like that play with him. I was a lot of head white too. Head white man. I thought they were good musicians. Fate was, yeah, but people in the band wasn't. Who was in the band? Oh, the most of them was from St. Louis. I can't think of them long. I don't think of anyone around, not their name, any more than Fate. Remember Foots Thomas? Foots, I remember him, yeah. Walter Foots Thomas? Mm-hmm.
Who'd you hear him? He was a great big fella that used to play drums. I don't know his name.
Who did you hear Foots Thomas with? Did you say that I played with him? Yeah. Well, no, not played with him. I said I knowed him.
I didn't play with him. Yeah, well where did he come from? I think he come from St. Louis, didn't he?
I don't know. I believe that's where he comes from. Didn't Dodge play drums with Fate Marable at once? Yeah, he played good boy with him. I didn't know. I didn't know.
I didn't know.
I didn't know.
I didn't know.
I believe that's where he comes from.
Didn't Dodge play drums with Fate Marable at once?
Yeah, he played good boy with him.
Do you ever know a guy named Norman Mason?
That name sounds familiar, but I don't believe I knew him.
He was with him some, I guess.
Huh?
He was with Fate Some. Oh. But...
I don't believe I knew him.
Maybe after, it was after then. I just wondered. I thought I'd throw that in somewhere.
What did he play?
Play trumpet then, I think. Well, but what got me?
